about: Render-speed benchmark: ultrafast 0.1.1 vs Remotion vs HyperFrames on one machine. Times are wall-clock seconds for the whole CLI command (start to finished MP4); see README.md for the method.

environment.ffmpeg_system: ffmpeg version 9.0.2 Copyright (c) 2000-2026 the FFmpeg developers
environment.ffmpeg_hyperframes: ffmpeg version n9.0.2-61-gd59078794d-20261121 Copyright (c) 2000-2026 the FFmpeg developers

ultrafast.device:
backend: vulkan
device:  NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090

machine_quiet.note: busy threads: CPU use of the whole machine over 3 s just before a run (nothing of the benchmark's running); load average also counts the benchmark's own previous run, so it is recorded but not used to gate runs; other CPU during a run: machine CPU minus the run's own cgroup. Runs with more than 1.5 threads of other load, or with another renderer working, were discarded and repeated.

angle-egl-c12.command: npx remotion render src/index.ts title out/title/remotion-angle-egl-c12.mp4 --crf 18 --concurrency 12 --gl=angle-egl
angle-egl-c12.label: --gl=angle-egl --concurrency 12

bundled-c12.command: npx remotion render build title out/title/remotion-bundled-c12.mp4 --crf 18 --concurrency 12
bundled-c12.label: prebuilt bundle, --concurrency 12

bundled-vulkan-c24.command: npx remotion render build title out/title/remotion-bundled-vulkan-c24.mp4 --crf 18 --concurrency 24 --gl=vulkan
bundled-vulkan-c24.label: prebuilt bundle, --gl=vulkan, --concurrency 24

bundled-vulkan-nvenc-c24.command: npx remotion render build title out/title/remotion-bundled-vulkan-nvenc-c24.mp4 --concurrency 24 --gl=vulkan --hardware-acceleration if-possible
bundled-vulkan-nvenc-c24.label: prebuilt bundle, --gl=vulkan, NVENC (--hardware-acceleration, no CRF), --concurrency 24
